meta.conventions: times in seconds. offset = raw_time - final_time. *_src = [raw_start, raw_end]. jump_s = offset change at a boundary = raw seconds removed (>0) or re-used/backward (<0). evidence_s = seconds in which that track is clearly heard (explained-energy > threshold). track_confidence "inferred" = track silent there, offset carried by continuity.

cut_character.definition: max over tracks of the fraction of removed raw frames >20 dB above that track noise floor: <0.1 pause_only, >=0.5 mostly_speech
